fields.name: scheduled_date
fields.help:
Scheduled date for the transfers to be processed.
              - If manually set then scheduled date for all transfers in batch will automatically update to this date.
              - If not manually changed and transfers are added/removed/updated then this will be their earliest scheduled date
                but this scheduled date will not be set for all transfers in batch.

window_actions.name: Batch Transfers
window_actions.help:
Wave transfers

Launch picking orders by aisle or area and regroup at packing zone. Ideal for large warehouses.

Batch transfers

Regroup multiple orders into one picking and consolidate at the packing zone.

Cluster transfers

Pick multiple orders in one trip and prepare orders as you pick. This reduces packing time and is ideal for small products.
